story.title: Story 3: The Adapter and the Seven Prompts

result.planSummary: Implemented the Story 3 adapter pipeline behind the unchanged Epic 02 seam: each operation now bounds input where DD-7 applies (summarizeToolResult head+tail+marker under maxInputChars), renders its kind's prompt, calls the host ModelCall, rejects empty/whitespace-only success text as retryable empty_output, and returns trimmed text with config-stamped provenance. Ported the POC's settled smoothing prompt verbatim into smoothing-v1 (the other six templates remain marked pre-dial-in with golden coverage). Handlers copy result.provenance into DerivedFormMetadata at all five form-write sites (messages landForm; turns rendering/projection/chunk-summary); the deterministic provider sets none, so its forms carry none. Wrote prompt goldens for all seven templates plus the two story suites covering TC-2.1, TC-2.2, and TC-2.3, demonstrated red on the new behaviors before implementing, and recorded the new Red files in the immutability manifest.

Replaced the pre-dial-in placeholder with the POC's settled smoothing system prompt, ported verbatim (AC-2.3)

findingsSurfaced: Degenerate-config corner: a maxInputChars smaller than the truncation marker itself (~80 chars) yields marker-only bounded content slightly over the bound; config validation only requires a positive number. Harmless at the 200_000 default and the test's 200, but dial-in could add a sane floor.

The POC smoothing prompt's protected-literals sentence was ported verbatim even though LHC's smoothing input carries no literals list — the clause is inert by design (post-epic-4-work.md retired the regex-extract-then-verify pattern); noted in the module comment so dial-in can reword under a new versioned name.

specDeviations: Retryable failure reasons are formatted `provider_failure: <kind>: <message>` rather than DD-3's literal 'reason is the kind string itself'. The Epic 02 queue copies the provider's reason verbatim onto exhausted forms (failTerminal sets form.reason and metadata.lastError from one string), and immutable Epic 02 tests pin that verbatim copy — so TC-2.3's required exhaustion shape ('reason provider_failure and last error naming empty_output') is only reachable if the adapter authors retryable reasons with the provider_failure code leading, matching the reason-code-before-first-colon convention Epic 02 established. Terminal kinds (auth, invalid_request) stay kind-led and land failed immediately, per the tech design's Error Contract. Story 4's classification tests (TC-3.1 asserts the same exhaustion shape for network) should consume this format.
result.recommendedNextStep: Run story verification for TC-2.1/2.2/2.3, then proceed to Story 4 (classification table, safeCall timeout/exception containment), which should adopt the provider_failure-led retryable reason format recorded in specDeviations.
